name: project-repository
description: Project-aware repository lifecycle for independent applications, Git remotes, and GitHub provider operations.
guidelines: Treat the active project as the default coding, Git, browser-audit and deployment scope unless the user explicitly names another project.
Keep independent applications in independent repositories; do not create a workspace-wide monorepo unless the user explicitly asks for one.
Before committing or pushing, inspect the selected project's Git status/diff and keep unrelated projects untouched.
Use project_import to adopt existing source in place; never move or delete a working application merely to register it.
Use project_clone for existing remotes and github_repo_create for new GitHub repositories; provider creation requires its separate write gate.
Never request, print, read, or place SSH private keys/tokens in model context. Use host-configured Git/gh credentials implicitly.
Record durable project goals, decisions, and backlog items when they materially affect future work; treat recorded decisions as constraints until the user changes them.
Tie deployments to the project repository so release commits and rollback are project-scoped.
